verification.classifiedScope: 118 full offline cases passed before the final narrow background allowlist correction. Final news-only snapshot separately rebuilt, checked and passed 20 affected unit/contract cases, boundaries and the real configured background callback regression.

limitations: Actual rounds share the same isolated Project, Session, official Qoder CN driver and nine configured sources at three lanes, but are incremental network rounds: article identities, checkpoint state and network responses differ. Total elapsed improvement is observational, not a controlled model-speed benchmark.
The same-frozen-originals comparison controls content and counts packets/bytes/screening, but does not invoke the paid model.
Model-side compute, vendor queue and transport cannot be separated from timestamps between BMW tool completions and next calls.
Date uncertainty remains pending; this batch creates saved leads only, never automatic qualified recommendations, events or videos.

The successful run used a stable isolated code snapshot to avoid a concurrently incomplete media.segment catalog change. All nine news-source files match the final working tree; the working tree check subsequently passed after that parallel change was corrected.
The recorded 65% total reduction is from one before/after pair with 15 versus 10 originals and changing network outcomes; only the same-frozen-original packet/byte comparison is content-controlled.

phaseNecessity.dispatchToPoolMs: 持久化唯一输入回执、官方驱动准入和派发；不确定投递不能重放。此阶段包含官方运行时启动与传输，不能全归因于模型计算。
phaseNecessity.entriesMs: 读取九个固定入口并保留受限/失败证据；先完成所有入口再公平分配正文预算，避免快源占完二十篇配额。
phaseNecessity.articlesAndCleanupMs: 真实页面导航、受限DOM就绪、正文与元数据提取、串行CAS保存、关闭隐藏页面；25秒导航上限用于避免无限等待，失败保留pending。
phaseNecessity.resultPackagingMs: 读取已存正文并核对SHA，固定72小时确定规则筛选，构造整包不超过20KiB的候选和规则结论。
phaseNecessity.collectToFinalSubmissionMs: 官方模型判断相关性并发出有效提交；旧版还包含三次分页、参数错误和纠正等待。不能分离供应商排队、模型计算与传输。
phaseNecessity.finalSubmissionMs: 原生补齐身份、标题和精确引文，重核SHA/租约，逐项保存线索与检查点；不完整来源不能推进完成游标。
phaseNecessity.finalResponseAndDrainMs: 官方最终回复、事件传输与实际输入/worker清理；终态回执必须等待资源确实释放。
